addServerDescription: Enter the address of the server you want to connect to.

serverStatus.error: Could not load, select it to retry
serverStatus.server-outdated: This server runs an older Sharkord version, desktop features are off until it is updated
serverStatus.app-outdated: This server needs a newer Sharkord app, desktop features are off until you update

errors.invalidUrl: That is not a valid server address.
errors.unreachable: Could not reach a Sharkord server at that address.

removeDialog.title: Remove server
removeDialog.message: Remove {{name}}? You will be signed out of this server on this device.

resetDialog.title: Reset the app?
resetDialog.message: This signs you out of every server and deletes all saved servers and settings on this device. The app restarts afterwards.

mediaDialog.title: Allow {{name}} to use your microphone and camera?
mediaDialog.message: {{name}} wants to use your microphone and camera, for example to join a voice channel. Once you allow it, you will not be asked again for this server.

settings.title: Desktop settings
settings.autoStartDescription: Start Sharkord automatically when you log in to your computer.
settings.closeToTrayDescription: Keep Sharkord running in the tray when you close the window. Turn it off if your desktop has no tray.
settings.startToTrayDescription: When Sharkord opens at login, keep it in the tray without showing the window. Open it again from the tray icon.
settings.connectAllOnStartup: Connect to all servers on startup
settings.connectAllOnStartupDescription: Load every server in the background when the app opens, so you get unread counts and notifications from all of them. Uses more memory.
settings.autoUpdateDescription: Download new versions of the app in the background and ask to restart once one is ready.
settings.throttleHiddenServersDescription: Slow down timers and rendering of servers you are not looking at. Saves CPU and battery, turn it off if background servers misbehave.
settings.performanceOverlayDescription: Show memory and CPU usage of the app in a small window.
settings.menuBarDescription: Show or hide the window menu bar. You can also use Ctrl+Shift+M.
settings.shortcutsDescription: Global shortcuts for the desktop app itself.

shortcut.toggleServerList: Show or hide the server list
shortcut.toggleMenuBar: Show or hide the menu bar

settings.updatesDescription: Keep the Sharkord app up to date.

unsupported.title: Updates unavailable
unsupported.description: This build of the app cannot update itself. Download new versions from the releases page.

idle.title: Not checked yet
idle.description: Check whether a newer version of the app is out.

checking.title: Checking for updates
checking.description: Looking for a newer version of the app.

up-to-date.title: You are up to date
up-to-date.description: You are running the latest version of the app.

ready.title: Update ready
ready.description: Version {{version}} is downloaded. Restart the app to install it.

error.title: Update check failed
error.description: Could not check for updates. Check your connection and try again.

settings.appFolderDescription: Where the app keeps your servers, logins and settings.

updateDialog.title: Update ready
updateDialog.message: Sharkord {{version}} has been downloaded. Restart now to install it, or it will be installed the next time you quit.

updateNotification.title: Update available
updateNotification.body: Sharkord {{version}} is out. Click to open the update settings.

serverPlaceholder.errorDescription: The server is not responding. Check that it is online and try again.
